title: Best Time to Visit Dubai: Month by Month | KWIKAR
description: Best time to visit Dubai, month by month: average day and night temperatures, sea temperature, rain, the 2026–27 events calendar and tips for summer trips.
h1: Best Time to Visit Dubai: Month by Month Weather and Events
summary: The best time to visit Dubai is from November to March, when days are warm (about 24–31°C), evenings are cool and outdoor parks such as Global Village and Dubai Miracle Garden are open. June to September is very hot, about 40°C by day, but quieter, and indoor attractions and evening tours run as usual. Rain is rare in any month.
glance: November to March: warm days, cool evenings
July and August: about 40–42°C by day
January: about 24°C by day, 14–15°C at night
Rare; one or two rainy days a month in winter

Dubai's seasons in short

SeasonMonthsWeatherBest for
Cool seasonDecember to FebruaryWarm days in the mid-20s °C, cool evenings, a few showersDesert safaris, outdoor parks, walking, evening cruises
SpringMarch and AprilWarm to hot days, pleasant eveningsBeaches, water parks, outdoor sightseeing before noon
SummerMay to SeptemberHot and humid, about 40°C by day in July and AugustIndoor attractions, early-morning or evening tours
AutumnOctober and NovemberHot turning warm, cooler nights by NovemberMost things; seasonal parks reopen

In short, November to March is the best time to visit Dubai for most travellers: days are warm rather than hot, evenings are comfortable outside and the seasonal parks are open. It is also the busiest time of year, so popular slots such as sunset at the Burj Khalifa fill up first.

These are long-term averages, rounded from two climate sources (listed at the end of this guide); real days can be a few degrees warmer or cooler. Rain is rare: Dubai usually sees only one or two rainy days a month from November to March, and almost none from May to October.

Best time for each kind of trip

  • Desert safari: October to April is the most comfortable. Safaris run all year, and in summer the evening trips are the better choice, as dune driving starts in the late afternoon and dinner is after dark. Our guide to morning vs evening desert safaris compares the two, or see the evening desert safari with Red Sands Camp.
  • Beaches and swimming: the sea stays above 20°C all year. March, April, October and November give warm water without the full summer heat. From June to September the water is above 30°C, so swimming is less refreshing.
  • Outdoor attractions: Dubai Miracle Garden is open from 8 October 2026 to 31 May 2027 and closed in summer. Global Village opened its 31st season on 14 October 2026 and runs through the cooler months; see our Global Village guide for timings.
  • Views from the top: November to March usually has the clearest air. Read the best time to visit Burj Khalifa for the best time of day as well.
  • Families: the cooler months suit children best, because you can mix outdoor and indoor plans. In summer, plan around indoor places such as Ski Dubai (about -4°C inside), Dubai Aquarium and The Green Planet. Our Dubai with kids guide has ideas by age.
  • Fewer crowds: June to September is the quietest period at most attractions, and good slots are easier to get.

What's on in 2026 and 2027

  • Dubai Shopping Festival (DSF): the 32nd edition runs from 4 December 2026 to 17 January 2027, with a nightly light show of lasers and drones at the bay between The Beach JBR and Bluewaters from 5 December.
  • New Year: late December is one of the busiest weeks of the year. Send your request early if you want a New Year cruise, dinner or viewing spot.
  • Ramadan 2027: astronomers expect it to begin around 8 February 2027, with Eid Al Fitr around 9 or 10 March; the exact dates follow the moon sighting. Attractions and tours keep running, but some hours change, so our team confirms timings for your date.

Visiting Dubai in summer

Summer is hot, but many visitors still come, because almost everything indoors keeps running. Do outdoor sightseeing before about 10am or after sunset, carry water, and plan the middle of the day around malls, museums and indoor attractions. A dhow dinner cruise or an evening safari works well, as both run after the hottest part of the day.

Whatever month you choose, send your plan and dates on WhatsApp. Our team checks availability for each tour and confirms the final price before you pay.
faqs: What is the best month to visit Dubai?

November, December, January, February and March are the best months for most visitors. Day highs are about 24–31°C and evenings are comfortable outside. January is the coolest month; November and March are warmer and a little quieter than the New Year period.
Is Dubai too hot to visit in summer?

From June to September day highs are about 39–42°C with high humidity, so long walks outside at midday are hard. Many visitors still come and plan indoor attractions for the day, with sightseeing early in the morning or after sunset.
Can you swim in the sea in Dubai in winter?
Yes. The sea stays at about 22°C even in January and February, which many visitors find fine for a swim on a sunny day.
When is the best time for a desert safari in Dubai?
October to April is the most comfortable. Safaris run all year; in summer choose an evening safari, which starts in the late afternoon and has dinner after dark.
When is the Dubai Shopping Festival 2026–27?
The 32nd Dubai Shopping Festival runs from 4 December 2026 to 17 January 2027.
Astronomers expect Ramadan 2027 to begin around 8 February 2027, with Eid Al Fitr around 9 or 10 March. The exact dates depend on the moon sighting.
Rarely. Most of the little rain falls between December and March, usually on one or two days a month, and there is almost none from May to October.
